lean.fidelity_note: The bounds (T1)–(T4), positive common time, localized oscillations and summable increments are retained. The formal statement also supplies equations connecting each step to Section 5 and later comparison bounds, fixes the strength constant as $18e^3$, and chooses the other constants before the admissible threshold function and initial frequency. Its envelope exponent can be chosen above any prescribed lower bound, without asserting that every larger exponent works. The contextual identifications are incomplete: the central amplitude is identified with the localized seed, but the central covector is not explicitly identified with its transported counterpart, and the first-wave direction and attained normalization are not restated. The supplied smooth step data should still be used when interpreting time regularity.
